TSTATCCIEWF-01: Installation Instructions Stage Settings: Temperature difference between your thermostat's setpoint and current indoor temperature which engages each stage of heating or cooling. Cycle Settings: A260512 Timers Five-Minute Compressor Timeguard This timer prevents compressor from starting unless it has been off for at least 5 minutes. Cycle Timer To prevent short cycling of the HVAC system, especially in the case where compressors are involved, the number of cycles per hour will be limited. This will be a settable parameter through the HVAC configuration in the App. Heating and cooling cycles will be set independently. For heating the following minimum run time (MRT) and minimum off time (MOT) defaults will be applied based on the number of cycles per hour: • Standard Gas - MRT = 7, MOT = 5 (5 Cycles per hour) • Standard Elec - MRT = 5, MOT = 3 (7.5 Cycles per hour) • Heat Pump - MRT = 15, MOT = 5 (3 Cycles per hour) • Dual Fuel - MRT = 15, MOT = 5 (3 Cycles per hour) For cooling, the following MRT and MOT defaults will be applied based on the number of cycles: • AC/HP - MRT = 15, MOT = 5 (3 Cycles per hour) Cycle rates can be increased or decreased in increments of 0.5 and will be inversely proportional to the MRT and MOT of reference of that system. For example, for a Standard Gas system if cycle rates is increased to 6, MRT = 5.83, MOT = 4.17. A260513 Offset Settings: Number of degrees to be added to the displayed temperature to calibrate or deliberately mis-calibrate the measured room temperature. Percentage to be added to the displayed humidity to calibrate or deliberately mis-calibrate the measured room humidity. A260514 Manufacturer reserves the right to change, at any time, specifications and designs without notice and without obligations. 7

TSTATCCIEWF-01: Installation Instructions Lockout Settings: Allows selection of outdoor temperature, above which or below which, the equipment is prevented from operating. Fan Settings: Allows you to select the amount of time the fan runs at the end of a heating or cooling cycle. A260515 Set Point Settings: Allows for selection of maximum heating, minimum cooling, default heat and cool setpoints. Also, allows adjustment of the heat/cool delta. A260517 Overcool to Dehumidify: Also called Dry Mode in SmartHome App, is a feature that, when enabled, will prompt the user to select a target humidity and 1, 2, or 3 degrees of overcooling to be allowed. Once selected, the system will run past the cooling setpoint, if necessary, to either the target humidity value or 1, 2, or 3 degrees past the cooling setpoint, whichever comes first. This feature does not change the blower speed, and will only be used when the system is in cooling mode. A260516 A260518 Manufacturer reserves the right to change, at any time, specifications and designs without notice and without obligations. 8

TSTATCCIEWF-01: Installation Instructions Accessory Settings: Will vary based on accessory type connected. For Humidifiers: Select the RH humidification set point. Select ON to allow the thermostat to control the connected humidifier. For Dehumidifiers: Select the RH dehumidification set point. Select ON to run fan with dehumidifier. Selecting NO will call for dehumidification, such as a standalone dehumidifier, without commanding the indoor unit blower to run. For Ventilators: Select the percent of time ventilator is needed to circulate fresh air per hour. Select the difference in temperature between indoor and outdoor temperatures where ventilator is allowed to run. A260519 Humidifier A260520 Dehumidifier Ventilator A260521 2.
